children.title: ^1^8[Contravention of order made during search action.]
children.text: ­ Whoever contravenes any order referred to in section 247(4) shall be punishable with ^1^9[simple imprisonment up to two years and with fine].

sections.text: ­ Whoever contravenes any order referred to in section 247(4) shall be punishable with ^1^9[simple imprisonment up to two years and with fine].

footnotes.text: Sub. for "Contravention of order made under section 247." by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
Sub. for "rigorous imprisonment which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
